generation.prompt_exact: Create actual production pixel art for a quiet Southern California managed Mediterranean courtyard background. Output exactly 1536x1024 landscape, fully opaque. This is ONLY the farthest sky and very subdued distant neighboring roof glimpse plate. No courtyard ground, walls, foreground architecture, vegetation, trees, birds, pots, furniture, functional objects, text or border. Small calm cool pale blue marine sky with restrained off-white soft cloud clusters, simple and quiet; a barely visible low warm-gray neighboring tile roof silhouette near the bottom 15 percent. The middle and top are predominantly sky. Detailed naturalistic pixel art with deliberately stepped edges, connected pixel clusters and restrained organic value ramps; retain visible pixel discipline rather than painted blur, no uniform noise, no vector look, no cartoon outlines. Soft upper-left diffuse daylight. This plate will be mostly occluded by separate warm buff plaster architecture and pale paving. Birds and independently placeable sprites will be the focal subjects; keep visual contrast low. Original scene, no borrowed layout.

Create actual production pixel art, exactly 1536x1024 landscape, transparent RGBA background with real alpha. A CLEAN EMPTY compact Mediterranean-style San Diego courtyard architecture and ground plate. Side-on yard stage with slight elevated visibility of the contact plane, upright architecture, no extreme perspective. Warm buff plaster enclosure with shallow left/right returns; plaster back wall top around y380, base around y650. Narrow asymmetrical closed dark weathered wood gate near the right side around x1240..1380, set into plaster, not central. One shallow pale stone side step at far left. Warm pale gray stone paving covers the entire lower canvas from wall contact around y650 down to the bottom edge y1024, edge to edge. Keep the full middle x300..1250,y650..980 open and quiet, reserved for separately editable birds and iron/wood/terracotta placeables. Very few sparse low-contrast paving seams, no strong stripes or busy texture. Small EMPTY recessed soil planting strip only at extreme left edge x0..170,y780..1024; no plant imagery. Tiny empty plaster wall niches at side edges are okay, but absolutely NO pots, planters, removable supports, furniture, decorative objects, plants, leaves, vines, grass, trees, distant vegetation, birds, feeders, baths, fountains or shadows of nonexistent objects anywhere. Above the wall silhouette is truly transparent sky; DO NOT render sky or checkerboard. Architecture, gate, step and paving are one flattened rigid compound plate; do not pretend they are separate parts. Naturalistic detailed pixel art with deliberate connected clusters, stepped contour edges, restrained stone/plaster wear and calm surfaces, coherent with finely shaded small garden object sprites; no blur, no photorealism, no thick cartoon outline or UI. Soft upper-left diffuse warm daylight, tight low-contrast structure contact shade to lower right. Make this a believable enclosed small courtyard, no broad vista, pergola, water or grand architecture.
